headword: {臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}

definitions.explanation: A business, shop, or facility closing temporarily outside of its regular closing days. May be due to owner illness, maintenance, weather, or special circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}です。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will be temporarily closed due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{行|い}きつけ→行きつけ：19123_ikitsuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{仕方|しかた}なく→仕方ない：11434_shikatanai⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: My usual café was temporarily closed, so I reluctantly went to a different shop.

notes:
USAGE:
Often seen on signs posted on shop doors or announced on social media and websites. A common sight in Japan, especially during typhoons, public health emergencies, or when an owner-operated shop needs a day off.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧ (notice of temporary closure)
- {臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ (we will be temporarily closed — polite)
- {臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}{日|び} (day of temporary closure)

cross_references.label: regular day off, regular closing day
